title: Manus Vindictae
subtitle: Everyone deserves their own home. The people here understand you, bond with you and always welcome you.

trails.title: Trail ① Manus Vindictae
trails.description: Information that most people know about your enemy, Manus Vindictae.

content.text:
Manus Vindictae is an infamous extremist organization.
Holding a grudge against humans and contempt for the mixed, these extreme racists only recognize the bodies ruled by arcanist's blood as "mankind."
They call themselves Manus Vindictae and believe they have the ability and power to change everything. They are dedicated to building a so-called proper world where arcanists will stand neck and neck with gods and enjoy the status they believe they deserve. In that case, humans, arcanists on the human side, and the mixed who tolerate the pollution of arcanist's blood will pay a huge price for their existence.
There is no doubt they are lunatic.
One of the two reasons for their madness is their brains: they have a strange prefrontal cortex or some unknown neurons; the other reason is hatred: in those dark ages, arcanists were discriminated, expelled, marginalized, and even slaughtered.
The tragedies that happen every day on the fringes of the society breed their revenge and keep strengthening this army of darkness.
Now they have come onto the stage. What they want is power, freedom, the one and only supreme status, and an overthrown world.

items.text: Manus Vindictae
I have been seeking a chance to talk to you from an equal position.
The name is Arcana.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Hello.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The leader behind Manus Vindictae.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Thou art acquainted with us.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: How wonderful. I am pleased.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Lady Vertin, here is an official offer that you joinest Manus Vindictae.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Ms. Arcana ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Why?

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Why? It's simple.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: I simply adore thy visage, emotionless in each "Storm".

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: I adore that which shineth in gold, nestled in thy cranium.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Thy flesh and blood belongen to us, if only a fraction of an ounce.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Do I have the right to say no?

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Absolutely. As I said, we are in an equal position.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: I ask that thou answer three questions.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Answer me, then thou shalt leave ... lest I ...

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Indulge in thy suffering.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Heh ... You can't. Don't waste your time.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Ms. Schneider, it is you who betrayed us first.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Is that so, Mr. Forget Me Not? It seems ... we have never reached an agreement ...

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: After all, your promise was a lie from the very beginning, Ms. Schneider. You should've known what was coming for you.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Heh heh ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: So, what are the three questions?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And how do you indulge in my suffering?

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Content thee, my child.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: The answer will be revealed for both of us.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: She pulls out countless black lines of slime from her temple. The slime turns into a wand.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: The first question.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: What is the ultimate purpose for the Foundation to create the "Storm"?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Wha-what? The Foundation ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Isn't the "Storm" created by you ...

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Time is up.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: I was expecting a better answer.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Start with her right hand. Her gesture with a gun bothereth me.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Uggh!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Schneider!!

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Shh. This is too much for her with a broken hand.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Then, the second question.  The Foundation experiments on the orphans of arcanists. Is that true?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes. We are looking for the arcane antibody immune to the "Storm" ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And I am the only successful subject.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: And the name of that antibody is?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Asymmetric ... Immune Protein G ...

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: A story in an inappropriate time, people call it a lie. Thou shalt not be misled by an abominable worm, Lady Vertin.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Or her limbs are not my next target.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: The last question.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: As the only one who bravest the "Storm" easily, I wonder ...

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: the arcanists thou hast met. How are they?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I will join you ...

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: They are not very well, are they?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... I rarely meet them. Most of them are deserted.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: In the mental hospital, the correctional institution, the abandoned orphanage, and the streets that no one sets foot on.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: We have been deserted by the principles of this world.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: As though we were born to be so ... eccentric ... and marginalized.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Thine eyes are not blinded, Lady Vertin.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Welcome home.
TO BE CONTINUED…
